query: What quantitative thresholds (e.g., percent cross‑logins, feature bypass rates) will trigger contamination remediation and what sensitivity analyses will be run if breached?

response.query: What quantitative thresholds (e.g., percent cross‑logins, feature bypass rates) will trigger contamination remediation and what sensitivity analyses will be run if breached?
response.answer: Contamination remediation is triggered at 5% cross-logins or 10% feature bypass rates. Sensitivity analyses will be conducted if these thresholds are breached.

results.title: Network Statement 2024 version 1.2 d.d. 1 July 2023
